gold: Linear or annular lupus erythematosus panniculitis of the scalp (LALPS)

selector.why: The presence of localized linear hair loss and hair thinning, along with dermoscopic findings of short vellus hairs, yellow dots, and honeycomb hyperpigmentation, specifically supports Lichen Planopilaris.

support_spans: Localized linear hair loss and hair thinning on the left scalp area were observed.
Dermoscopic examination of the alopecic area revealed several short vellus hairs, yellow dots, and honeycomb hyperpigmentation; however, broken hairs were not seen.
